map.根据目标纯度与原料气纯度，计算所需高纯气和稀释气的配气流量: From the target purity and feed-gas purity, compute the required high-purity and dilution-gas flow rates for blending.
map.混合后纯度 = Σ(各气源纯度 × 流量) ÷ 总流量: Mixed purity = sum(each source purity times flow) / total flow
map.基于气体纯度混合模型：目标纯度由原料气、稀释气纯度与流量加权混合得到；反向可求稀: Based on a gas purity blending model: the target purity is a weighted mix of feed-gas, dilution-gas purity and flow; inverted it gives the dilution ratio, for high-purity supply design.
map.💡 高纯气量 = Q × (C目标 - C稀释) / (C原料 - C稀释)；稀: Tip: high-purity gas = Q times (C target minus C dilution) / (C feed minus C dilution); dilution gas = Q minus high-purity gas; for gas blending and mixing scenarios
map.原料气纯度须大于目标纯度，否则无法配制: Feed-gas purity must be greater than target purity, otherwise it cannot be prepared
map.稀释气纯度通常为0（如空气稀释），也可输入非零值: Dilution-gas purity is usually 0 (e.g. air dilution), non-zero values can also be entered
map.流量单位为标准立方米每小时（Nm³/h）: Flow unit is standard cubic meters per hour (Nm3/h)
map.实验室配气：由目标浓度算高纯气与稀释气的流量配比: Lab gas blending: from target concentration compute the high-purity and dilution-gas flow ratio
map.工业混合气：核算连续运行下的日消耗量: Industrial mixed gas: check daily consumption under continuous operation
map.钢瓶需求测算：为采购与供气方案提供依据: Cylinder demand estimation: basis for procurement and supply planning
map.算法：要求 原料气纯度 > 目标纯度 > 稀释气纯度，否则无法配制。高纯气量 =: Algorithm: require feed-gas purity greater than target purity greater than dilution-gas purity, otherwise cannot prepare. High-purity gas = total flow times (target purity minus dilution purity) / (feed purity minus dilution purity); dilution gas = total flow minus high-purity gas; their shares are divided by total flow; daily demand = hourly amount times 24.
map.例：目标 25%、原料气 99.9%、稀释气 0%、总流量 100Nm³/h →: Example: target 25 percent, feed gas 99.9 percent, dilution gas 0 percent, total flow 100 Nm3/h gives high-purity 25.03 Nm3/h (25.03 percent), dilution 74.97 Nm3/h (74.97 percent), daily high-purity 600.6 Nm3, dilution 1799.4 Nm3. If target 10 percent, feed 99.99 percent, total 50 Nm3/h gives high-purity 5.00, dilution 45.00 Nm3/h, ratio 10 percent to 90 percent. Target 50 percent, feed 99.9 percent, total 200 Nm3/h gives high-purity 100.10, dilution 99.90 Nm3/h, ratio 50.05 percent to 49.95 percent.
map.若用纯氮、纯氩等不含目标组分的气体稀释，填 0 即可；若稀释气本身含少量目标组分: If diluting with pure nitrogen, pure argon or other gas containing no target component, 0 is fine; if the dilution gas itself contains a little target component, enter its actual content, otherwise the computed high-purity amount will be too high and the actual concentration too low.
map.工具按标准状态 Nm³/h 计算，配比是体积分数，与温压无关。但实际流量计读数若: The tool computes in standard state Nm3/h; the ratio is a volume fraction independent of temperature and pressure. But if the actual flow-meter reading is not at standard conditions (e.g. real m3/h), convert to Nm3/h first before substituting.
map.气体纯度流量计算器用于气体配气混合场景，根据目标纯度、原料气纯度和稀释气纯度，计: The gas purity flow calculator is for gas blending and mixing scenarios; from target purity, feed-gas purity and dilution-gas purity it computes the required high-purity and dilution-gas amounts. It suits standard-gas preparation, shield-gas mixing and process-gas blending.
map.支持自定义稀释气纯度（如空气含0.04% CO₂）: Supports custom dilution-gas purity (e.g. air with 0.04 percent CO2)
map.自动验证原料气纯度与目标纯度逻辑关系: Automatically validates the feed-purity versus target-purity logic
map.计算配气比例和日用量估算: Computes blending ratio and daily-usage estimate
map.结果直观显示，支持一键复制: Results shown intuitively, one-click copy supported
